                            <div class="custom-vertical-card__text-block">
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">CRISIS RESPONSE</p>
                              <h3 class="custom-vertical-card__title">Building Resilient Communities: Waze's Role in Sustainable Crisis Response During the Greater LA Wildfires</h3>
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How real-time data, community collaboration, and emergency partnerships enhanced crisis response and built long-term resilience during major environmental disasters.</p>

                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">HIGHWAY SAFETY</p>
                              <h3 class="custom-vertical-card__title">Improving Highway Safety: How DER-MG Leverages Real-Time Data</h3>
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How the Department of Highways of Minas Gerais uses real-time data to proactively address hazards, optimize road maintenance, and keep drivers informed across a vast state road network.</p>

                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">INCIDENT MANAGEMENT</p>
                              <h3 class="custom-vertical-card__title">Navigating Challenges: How Waze Improves Traffic Management and Safety</h3>
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How the city of Rio de Janeiro leverages community-sourced data to manage complex traffic flow, improve emergency response times, and issue real-time flood warnings.</p>

                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">ROAD SAFETY</p>
                              <h3 class="custom-vertical-card__title">Saving Lives: How Real-Time Data is Making a Difference</h3>
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How the city of Quito leverages community-driven waze data to reduce accidents, address high-risk roadways, and foster a national culture of road safety.</p>

                            <div class="custom-vertical-card__text-block">
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">MOBILITY PLANNING</p>
                              <h3 class="custom-vertical-card__title">Reducing Traffic in Ghent City Center</h3>
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How Ghent executed a groundbreaking circulation plan in partnership with local waze editors to cut city-center traffic by 40%, improve safety, and boost sustainable transit.</p>

                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">CRISIS RELIEF</p>
                              <h3 class="custom-vertical-card__title">Keeping People Safe During a Natural Disaster</h3>
                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How the Waze Map Editor Community provided real-time route updates, evacuation support, and shelter navigation during the Taal Volcano eruption in the Philippines.</p>

                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__eyebrow">FIRST RESPONDER TECH</p>

                              <p class="custom-vertical-card__description">How emergency responders in Chicago and across the country use waze and HAAS Alert’s Safety Cloud service to warn drivers earlier, preventing roadside collisions and protecting first responders.</p>

                      <button class="glue-expansion-panel__button custom-accordion__item-button ts-custom-accordion-button" type="button" aria-expanded="false"> <span class="custom-accordion__item-title">Overview</span> <span class="custom-accordion__item-chevron">
                          <svg class="custom-accordion__chevron-svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M12.0001 15.29L5.71012 9.00001C5.32012 8.61001 4.69012 8.61001 4.30012 9.00001C3.91012 9.39001 3.91012 10.02 4.30012 10.41L11.3001 17.41C11.6901 17.8 12.3201 17.8 12.7101 17.41L19.7101 10.41C20.1001 10.02 20.1001 9.39001 19.7101 9.00001C19.3201 8.61001 18.6901 8.61001 18.3001 9.00001L12.0001 15.29Z" fill="currentColor" />
                          </svg></span> </button>
                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">What is waze and how does it work?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze is a free, community-driven GPS navigation application for iOS, Android, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto used by over 200 million drivers worldwide. Waze collects real-time GPS data and crowdsourced hazard reports from its driver community to dynamically calculate the fastest routes around traffic congestion, accidents, speed traps, and road work.
                              <br>
                              Waze is designed exclusively for private motor vehicles and motorcycles.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How does waze differ from Google Maps and Apple Maps?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              While Google owns Waze, each platform serves a distinct navigation purpose:
                              <br>
                              <ul id="rte-5f49dcb0-bcd8-11f1-81cb-2943868826b4">
                              <li><b>Waze</b>: Focuses strictly on vehicle navigation. It relies on real-time community reporting and dynamic routing. It's a specialized driver copilot.</li>
                              <li><b>Google Maps</b>: Focuses on comprehensive geographic exploration, offering multi-modal transit (walking, public transit, biking), satellite imagery, street view, and detailed local business listings.</li>
                              <li><b>Apple Maps</b>: Focuses on integrated iOS ecosystem navigation, featuring detailed 3D city landmarks, privacy-focused turn-by-turn guidance, and seamless integration with Apple devices.</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">Is the waze app free to use?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Yes, the waze app is 100% free to download and use across all supported platforms, including iOS, Android, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and Android Automotive OS (AAOS) built-in vehicle systems.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="glue-expansion-panel custom-accordion__category ts-custom-accordion-item" data-cy="customAccordionCategory">
                      <button class="glue-expansion-panel__button custom-accordion__item-button ts-custom-accordion-button" type="button" aria-expanded="false"> <span class="custom-accordion__item-title">Google Gemini AI Features</span> <span class="custom-accordion__item-chevron">
                          <svg class="custom-accordion__chevron-svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M12.0001 15.29L5.71012 9.00001C5.32012 8.61001 4.69012 8.61001 4.30012 9.00001C3.91012 9.39001 3.91012 10.02 4.30012 10.41L11.3001 17.41C11.6901 17.8 12.3201 17.8 12.7101 17.41L19.7101 10.41C20.1001 10.02 20.1001 9.39001 19.7101 9.00001C19.3201 8.61001 18.6901 8.61001 18.3001 9.00001L12.0001 15.29Z" fill="currentColor" />
                          </svg></span> </button>
                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How does Google Gemini AI work in waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Google Gemini AI brings conversational intelligence to Waze through three key capabilities:
                              <br>
                              <ul id="rte-4ce85b50-bcd8-11f1-81cb-2943868826b4">
                              <li><b>Conversational Incident Reporting: </b>Drivers can state hazards out loud in natural language (e.g., "Looks like traffic is backed up from a crash ahead") without tapping buttons.</li>
                              <li><b>Conversational Map Updates: </b>Saying "This road is closed for construction" logs an edit request for volunteer Map Editors to verify.</li>
                              <li><b>Natural-Language Destination Search: </b>Drivers can search complex criteria out loud, such as "Find a gas station nearby with cheap premium fuel" or "Find open coffee shops with a drive-thru".</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">What is waze map mate?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze map mate is a community feature powered by Google Gemini AI that allows drivers to keep the local real-time map updated using natural voice commands. Drivers simply describe what they see on the road out loud to log live map edits and incident reports.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="glue-expansion-panel custom-accordion__category ts-custom-accordion-item" data-cy="customAccordionCategory">
                      <button class="glue-expansion-panel__button custom-accordion__item-button ts-custom-accordion-button" type="button" aria-expanded="false"> <span class="custom-accordion__item-title">Trip Planning &amp; Pre-Drive Setup</span> <span class="custom-accordion__item-chevron">
                          <svg class="custom-accordion__chevron-svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M12.0001 15.29L5.71012 9.00001C5.32012 8.61001 4.69012 8.61001 4.30012 9.00001C3.91012 9.39001 3.91012 10.02 4.30012 10.41L11.3001 17.41C11.6901 17.8 12.3201 17.8 12.7101 17.41L19.7101 10.41C20.1001 10.02 20.1001 9.39001 19.7101 9.00001C19.3201 8.61001 18.6901 8.61001 18.3001 9.00001L12.0001 15.29Z" fill="currentColor" />
                          </svg></span> </button>
                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I search for a destination and start navigation?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <ol id="rte-44a2f6f1-bcd6-11f1-81cb-2943868826b4" start="1">
                              <li>Tap the search bar.</li>
                              <li>Type an address, point of interest, or contact name.</li>
                              <li>Tap the destination.</li>
                              <li>Tap <b>Go now</b> to begin navigation.</li>
                              </ol>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I plan trips, schedule drives, and view trip times?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              To schedule a future trip or check predictive traffic before leaving, enter your destination in the search bar and select <b>Leave later </b>(or tap the menu icon and select <b>Plan a drive</b>). Waze displays a predictive traffic graph showing estimated drive times and traffic peaks across departure hours. Select your desired arrival time and tap <b>Save</b>. Waze will send real-time departure reminders based on live conditions. Ensure notifications and location permissions are set under <b>Settings &gt; Plan a drive &gt; Time to leave reminder</b>. You can also connect your phone calendar under <b>Settings &gt; Calendar sync</b> to automatically schedule drives for calendar events with valid addresses.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I view turn-by-turn directions or compare alternate routes?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <ul id="rte-44a2f6f2-bcd6-11f1-81cb-2943868826b4">
                              <li><b>View Directions List: </b>Tap the top bar of the screen during active navigation to open step-by-step route directions.</li>
                              <li><b>View Alternate Routes: </b>Tap your destination, select <b>View routes</b>, and swipe up to compare alternate driving options and ETA differences.</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I change vehicle profiles in waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              To update your vehicle profile among options like Private Car, Taxi, Motorcycle, or EV:
                              <br>
                              1. Open <b>Settings</b>.
                              <br>
                              2. Tap <b>Vehicle details</b> or <b>Vehicle type</b>.
                              <br>
                              3. Select your vehicle profile to automatically adapt routing algorithms and eligible lane access, such as HOV or bus lanes.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">What is waze motorcycle mode?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Motorcycle mode is a specialized navigation setting tailored for two-wheeled vehicles. It provides access to narrow roads and shortcuts inaccessible to standard cars, displays surface hazard alerts such as potholes and speed bumps, and uses ETA algorithms tuned specifically to motorcycle traffic speeds.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How does electric vehicle (EV) routing and charging work in waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze allows EV owners to enable EV features and select their specific plug type (such as CCS1, NACS, or Type 2) under <b>Settings &gt; Vehicle details &gt; EV Settings</b>. You can then search for EV charging stations in the search bar or view compatible stations along your route, showing real-time plug availability and charger speeds.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I manage toll roads, passes, and low-emission zones in waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <ul class="rte2-style-ul" id="rte-8914bf22-adff-11f1-a81c-2bd11d3297b1" data-pm-slice="3 3 []">
                              <li><b>Avoid Tolls &amp; Toll Bridges: </b>Go to <b>Settings &gt; Navigation</b> and toggle on <b>Avoid toll roads</b>. Waze will recalculate your route using free public roads.</li>
                              <li><b>Toll &amp; Passes: </b>Go to <b>Settings &gt; Navigation &gt; Custom Passes</b> to add passes you own (such as EZPass, FasTrak, or regional carpool permits). This prevents Waze from detouring around tolls you already pay for and allows it to incorporate restricted areas you are allowed to travel through.</li>
                              <li><b>Estimate Toll Prices: </b>Swipe up on the suggested routes screen before navigating to view upfront estimated toll costs.</li>
                              <li><b>Low-Emission Zones: </b>waze automatically checks environmental driving restrictions and permits added in your vehicle details to prevent route violations.</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I manage stops and navigation mid-trip?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <ul class="rte2-style-ul" id="rte-b5fedac0-adff-11f1-a81c-2bd11d3297b1" data-pm-slice="3 3 []">
                              <li><b>Add a Stop: </b>Tap the ETA bar at the bottom of the screen, tap <b>Add a stop</b>, search for the location, and select <b>Go</b>.</li>
                              <li><b>Stop Navigation: </b>Tap the ETA bar at the bottom of the screen and select <b>Stop</b>.</li>
                              <li><b>Shut Off Waze: </b>Tap the menu icon and select <b>Shut off</b> to close Waze completely.</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do audio directions and the waze audio player work?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              "Less Chatty Mode" is an audio setting that reduces voice directions while keeping critical safety alerts active. It silences routine turn-by-turn prompts while continuing to announce mandatory turns, lane changes, and high-risk road hazards. You can enable it under <b>Settings &gt; Voice &amp; Sound &gt; Voice Directions &gt; Less Chatty</b>.
                              <br>
                              The built-in waze audio player connects natively with third-party audio apps. By tapping the <b>Audio Player icon</b> on the map screen, drivers can control playback for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Audible, iHeartRadio, and Podcasts without leaving the navigation screen.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I share real-time trip progress (ETA) with friends?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              You can share your live location, route progress, and real-time ETA with friends or family using the <b>Share drive</b> feature:
                              <br>
                              <ol class="rte2-style-ol" id="rte-8914bf21-adff-11f1-a81c-2bd11d3297b1" start="1" data-pm-slice="3 1 []">
                              <li>Start active navigation in waze.</li>
                              <li>Tap the <b>ETA bar</b> at the bottom of the map screen.</li>
                              <li>Tap <b>Share drive</b> and choose your preferred messaging app, email, or contact.</li>
                              </ol>Recipients will receive a secure web link showing your live progress on the map and your updated arrival time.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I find parking or request roadside help in waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <b>Parking: </b>Tap your destination, select nearby parking options, and tap <b>Park here</b>.
                              <br><b>Roadside Help: </b>Tap the orange <b>Report menu</b> icon, select <b>Roadside help</b>, and choose whether to request assistance from fellow wazers, professional roadside service, or emergency services.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do speed trap and police alerts work?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze automatically displays visual and audio warnings on your map as you approach speed cameras, red-light cameras, and reported police traps. These alerts are generated in real time through crowdsourced reports from nearby drivers. You can customize audio alerts under <b>Settings &gt; Sound &amp; Voice &gt; Reports &gt; Police</b>.
                              <br>
                              Waze also includes a built-in speedometer that displays your current driving speed alongside the local speed limit. You can set waze to play a warning chime when you reach the exact speed limit or when you exceed it by 5%, 10%, or a specific threshold (e.g., 5 mph over). Manage this setting under <b>Settings &gt; Speedometer</b>.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I find the cheapest gas prices along my route?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Tap the search bar, select <b>Gas stations</b>, and choose your preferred sort option (<b>Price</b> or <b>Distance</b>). Waze will display nearby stations with community-updated fuel prices (e.g., Regular, Midgrade, Premium, Diesel) and allow you to add the station as a quick stop along your existing route.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">What happens if I encounter a sudden road closure, accident, or crisis?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze automatically recalculates your route in real time - often directing you through side streets or bypasses - to get you back on track with minimal delay.
                              <br><b>Crisis Support: </b>Type <b>Crisis</b> in the search bar to display regional emergency and crisis support locations.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                          <svg class="custom-accordion__chevron-svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">

                          </svg></span> </button>
                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">Does waze support Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and Android Automotive (AAOS)?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <ul class="rte2-style-ul" id="rte-54676012-ae00-11f1-8eb8-135da00d1996" data-pm-slice="3 3 []">
                              <li><b>Apple CarPlay &amp; Android Auto: </b>Supported natively. Connect your smartphone to project waze maps, audio alerts, and voice controls directly onto your dashboard display.</li>
                              <li><b>Android Automotive OS (AAOS): </b>Download waze directly from the vehicle's Google Play Store. You must install waze on your smartphone first to create an account before using standalone AAOS navigation.</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">Does waze work offline without cellular data?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze requires an active internet connection (5G, LTE, or Wi-Fi) to calculate initial routes, update live traffic, and process hazard reports. If cellular signal is lost mid-drive, pre-loaded turn-by-turn guidance will continue, but dynamic rerouting and live community updates will pause until connectivity returns.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">Why does my phone get warm or lose battery quickly, and how do I fix it?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze continuously processes high-precision GPS tracking, real-time data sync, and map rendering simultaneously, which consumes significant hardware power. To reduce device heat and battery consumption:
                              <br>
                              <ul class="rte2-style-ul" id="rte-823943a0-ae00-11f1-8eb8-135da00d1996">
                              <li>Keep your smartphone plugged into a dedicated active car charger while driving.</li>
                              <li>Enable Dark Mode under <b>Settings &gt; Display &amp; Map &gt; Scheme &gt; Night</b>.</li>
                              <li>Ensure location access is set to "<b>While Using App</b>" in your phone system settings.</li>
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I fix "Searching for Network" or "No GPS" errors in waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              <ol class="rte2-style-ol" id="rte-54676011-ae00-11f1-8eb8-135da00d1996" start="1" data-pm-slice="3 3 []">
                              <li><b>Toggle Connectivity</b>: Switch Airplane Mode ON for 5 seconds, then OFF.</li>
                              <li><b>Check Permissions</b>: Ensure your phone settings grant Waze Precise Location or High Accuracy access.</li>
                              <li><b>Adjust Phone Position</b>: Move your smartphone away from metallic shields or glove compartments toward an open view of the windshield.</li>
                              <li><b>Reset App:</b> Force-close waze or clear the app cache in your device settings.</li>
                              </ol>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="glue-expansion-panel custom-accordion__category ts-custom-accordion-item" data-cy="customAccordionCategory">
                      <button class="glue-expansion-panel__button custom-accordion__item-button ts-custom-accordion-button" type="button" aria-expanded="false"> <span class="custom-accordion__item-title">Community Editing &amp; Advertising</span> <span class="custom-accordion__item-chevron">
                          <svg class="custom-accordion__chevron-svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                            <path d="M12.0001 15.29L5.71012 9.00001C5.32012 8.61001 4.69012 8.61001 4.30012 9.00001C3.91012 9.39001 3.91012 10.02 4.30012 10.41L11.3001 17.41C11.6901 17.8 12.3201 17.8 12.7101 17.41L19.7101 10.41C20.1001 10.02 20.1001 9.39001 19.7101 9.00001C19.3201 8.61001 18.6901 8.61001 18.3001 9.00001L12.0001 15.29Z" fill="currentColor" />
                          </svg></span> </button>
                      <div class="glue-expansion-panel__content custom-accordion__item-promo ts-custom-accordion-content">
                        <div class="custom-accordion__item-description">
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How are waze maps kept up to date?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze maps are maintained by a global network of over 500,000 volunteer Map Editors processing over 2 billion edits annually. Editors update road geometry, construction zones, and local detours using satellite imagery, official government feeds, and user-submitted Gemini voice reports via the <b>Waze Map Editor (WME)</b> online.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">What is the waze for cities program?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze for cities is a free data-sharing partnership between waze and municipal governments or transit agencies. Cities share planned construction and road closure feeds with waze (which also syncs to Google Maps), while receiving anonymized driver speed and traffic flow data to optimize emergency responses and traffic signals.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do local businesses advertise on waze?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Waze ad inventory is officially part of Google Ads Performance Max (PMax) for Store Goals. Businesses can connect with over 200 million drivers worldwide by leveraging existing PMax campaigns to automatically format creative assets into "Promoted Places in Navigation" pins along driver routes. This allows local and global brands to reach nearby drivers in real time with zero friction and no additional setup.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div class="custom-accordion__qa-item">
                            <h4 class="custom-accordion__question-title">How do I become a waze map editor?</h4>
                            <div class="custom-accordion__answer-body">
                              Anyone with a waze account can become a map editor. You can log into the online waze map editor (WME) at waze.com/editor using your waze credentials to start editing maps, fixing road details, and helping local drivers navigate better.
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
